file_roles.evidence: Removes the '#ifdef _LIBCPP_VERSION appendStr("std::" ... _LIBCPP_ABI_NAMESPACE "::pair")' branch and adds an is_std_pair path in typenameHelper so names are always 'std::pair<T1,T2>'; the old libc++ name 'std::__1::pair' leaked into moc output.

rationale: The Android on macOS build failed in generated moc code that spelled the type as std::__1::pair, which is not valid there. The commit message says the type name normalization in QMetaType produced libc++-specific names, and the diff changes that normalization. The failing compile unit is a moc-generated file outside the gold set. The symptom file is the generated moc output, named in the build log.
